pipelinesRun.topic:
Run full pipeline on luxury destination wedding photography 
business called Off The Ground Icon. Website is otgicon.com. 
Photographer shoots destination weddings anywhere in the world 
including Santorini, Tuscany, Tulum and Hawaii. Has one 
beautiful highlight reel and a photo gallery. Currently only 
getting word of mouth leads. Goal is to go viral on Instagram 
and TikTok, drive traffic to booking page, and convert viewers 
into destination wedding bookings. Ideal client is couples with 
a budget of $5000 plus looking for luxury photography and 
videography for their destination wedding.
